narratives.Overview:
> Recut 2026-09-13 to Bound-remedy on successor lean 5650050406, synthesis accepted 5650054019. Next-build is this list, not the original Expected.

## Summary

The sanctioned Grok dispatch path did not complete. That operator tax is real. The filed diagnosis cannot bind: inherited CLAUDE_* variables are not the occupancy owner producer, honouring DEFT_SESSION_ID as a blanket override inverts host-authoritative occupancy (#4066), and the deposit half is #4443.

## Bound remedy (this number)

- Split the conjunct. Deposit reconstitution stays on #4443.
- Do not honour DEFT_SESSION_ID over a derived host owner as a blanket override.
- Repro the child argv --host value. Remainder is host flag / derivation, not inherited CLAUDE_* as the owner producer.
- Recovery must preserve a presented identity, not infer ownership from a previous invocation.

## Out of scope

- #4443 deposit reconstitution. Do not close that issue from this recut.
- #4410 occupancy deny steal recipe.
- Treating CLAUDE_* leak as the owner producer.
- Honouring DEFT_SESSION_ID over a derived host owner.

## Relationship

- #4443 occupies linked-worktree deposit reconstitution.
- #4431 occupies payload-host mint on claim.
- #4424 kept traveling host-hook trees as fences.
